integration_policy: Use GeoMaster as EasyGEE's geospatial method backend. Do not bulk-copy examples into EasyGEE; route to the smallest relevant GeoMaster reference and keep EasyGEE responsible for GEE auth, quota, catalog, browser, and export orchestration.

backend_methods.gee_first: Use Earth Engine/geemap for cloud-scale catalog access, compositing, reducers, visualization, and exports.
backend_methods.local_first: Use local GIS/remote-sensing libraries for local files, CRS-heavy operations, windowed raster IO, topology, network, point cloud, or COG/STAC processing.
backend_methods.hybrid: Use GEE for data access or preprocessing, then local tools for COG/STAC, ML, advanced statistics, or exact file-based GIS work.
backend_methods.catalog_first: Search and verify candidate datasets before analysis.
backend_methods.browser_first: Use EasyGEE Map Console for AOI drawing, layer inspection, annotations, or visual QA before computation.

entries.easygee_use: Decide units/projection for local or hybrid calculations; warn against area/distance in geographic or Web Mercator CRS.
Pick local Python libraries and IO patterns for local_first or post-export hybrid steps.
Supplement EasyGEE dataset QA with mission, index, SAR, hyperspectral, and preprocessing methods.
Route model training, inference, feature engineering, and evaluation to local or hybrid workflows.
Bridge EasyGEE outputs into desktop GIS or database workflows when browser preview is insufficient.
Choose domain-specific assumptions, indicators, and validation cautions.
Prefer local or hybrid workflows for topology, routing, trajectories, service areas, and 3D analysis.
Plan cloud-native local/hybrid data handling after GEE export or outside GEE.
Frame outputs and validation around applied decision contexts.
Translate EasyGEE patterns to non-Python environments when explicitly requested.
Compare GEE catalog options with external STAC, open data, and platform alternatives.
Diagnose local GIS stack, CRS, geometry, memory, and performance failures.
Retrieve a local GIS or remote-sensing example only after method routing identifies the backend.
Route specialized statistics, optimization, privacy, provenance, and reproducibility questions to local/hybrid methods.
